```{r}
trees_2025 <- trees %>%
  filter(Year == 2025)
```
```{r}
treated_sites <- c("SFF1", "SFF5", "SFF7", "SFF8", "SFF10", "SFS4")
untreated_sites <- c("SFF2", "SFF3", "SFF4", "SFF6", "SFF9", "BTN4")

summary_table <- trees_2025 %>%
  mutate(Treatment = case_when(
    Site %in% treated_sites ~ "Treated",
    Site %in% untreated_sites ~ "Untreated",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Treatment)) %>%
  group_by(Treatment) %>%
  summarise(
    `Tree count` = n(),  # total trees
    `MOG count` = sum(OGness %in% c(2,3), na.rm = TRUE),  # trees where OGness = 2 or 3
    `MOG live count` = sum(OGness %in% c(2,3) & !Tree_condition %in% c(2,5,6,8,9,10,11,12), na.rm = TRUE),
    `Surveyed ha` = 3  # fixed value for both
  )
summary_table
```

```{r}
species_counts2025 <- trees %>%
  filter(Year == 2025) %>%
  group_by(SpeciesID) %>%
  summarise(Total = n())

  filter(Year == 2025, Tree_condition == 6) %>%
  group_by(SpeciesID) %>%
  summarise(New_Mortalities = n())

percent_6_2025 <- species_counts2025 %>%
  left_join(species_cond6_2025, by = "SpeciesID") %>%
  mutate(New_Mortalities = ifelse(is.na(New_Mortalities), 0, New_Mortalities),

  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "dodgerblue") +
  labs(title = "Percentage of New Deaths by species, 2025",
       x = "Species ID",
       y = "Percent (%)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

```{r}
treated_sites <- c("SFF1", "SFF5", "SFF7", "SFF8", "SFF10", "SFS4")
untreated_sites <- c("SFF2", "SFF3", "SFF4", "SFF6", "SFF9", "BTN4")

  ))

  filter(Year == 2025) %>%
  group_by(Treatment, SpeciesID) %>%
  summarise(Total = n(), .groups = "drop")

species_cond6_2025 <- trees %>%
  filter(Year == 2025, Tree_condition == 6) %>%
  group_by(Treatment, SpeciesID) %>%
  summarise(New_Mortalities = n(), .groups = "drop")

  left_join(species_cond6_2025, by = c("Treatment", "SpeciesID")) %>%
  mutate(
    New_Mortalities = ifelse(is.na(New_Mortalities), 0, New_Mortalities),
    Percent_New_Mortality = (New_Mortalities / Total) * 100
  )
```

```{r}

site_totals_2025 <- trees %>%
  filter(Year == 2025) %>%
  group_by(Site) %>%
  summarise(Total_Trees = n())

site_condition6_2025 <- trees %>%
  filter(Year == 2025, Tree_condition == 6) %>%
  group_by(Site) %>%
  summarise(Condition6_Trees = n())

site_condition137_2025 <- trees %>%
  filter(Year == 2025, Tree_condition %in% c(1, 3, 7)) %>%
  group_by(Site) %>%
  summarise(Condition137_Trees = n())

site_percent_2025 <- site_condition6_2025 %>%
  full_join(site_condition137_2025, by = "Site") %>%
  mutate(
    Condition6_Trees = ifelse(is.na(Condition6_Trees), 0, Condition6_Trees),
    Condition137_Trees = ifelse(is.na(Condition137_Trees), 0, Condition137_Trees),
    Percent_Condition6 = (Condition6_Trees / (Condition6_Trees + Condition137_Trees)) * 100
  )

treated_sites <- c("SFF1", "SFF5", "SFF7", "SFF8", "SFF10", "SFS4")
untreated_sites <- c("SFF2", "SFF3", "SFF4", "SFF6", "SFF9", "BTN4")

site_percent_2025 <- site_percent_2025 %>%
  mutate(Treatment = case_when(
    Site %in% treated_sites ~ "Treated",
    Site %in% untreated_sites ~ "Untreated",
    TRUE ~ "Other"
  ))

Newdeaths<-ggplot(site_percent_2025, aes(x = reorder(Site, Percent_Condition6), y = Percent_Condition6, fill = Treatment)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Treated" = "#e6b855", "Untreated" = "#435e55ff", "Other" = "grey80")) +
  labs(
    title = NULL,
    x = "",
    y = "Percent",
    fill = "Treatment Group"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5))
```

```{r}
filtered_2025 <- trees %>%
  filter(Year == 2025, !Tree_condition %in% c(2, 5, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12))

site_totals_filtered <- filtered_2025 %>%
  group_by(Site) %>%
  summarise(Total_Trees = n())

treated_sites <- c("SFF1", "SFF5", "SFF7", "SFF8", "SFF10", "SFS4")
untreated_sites <- c("SFF2", "SFF3", "SFF4", "SFF6", "SFF9", "BTN4") 

site_totals_filtered <- site_totals_filtered %>%
  mutate(Treatment = case_when(
    Site %in% treated_sites ~ "Treated",
    Site %in% untreated_sites ~ "Untreated",
    TRUE ~ "Other"  # Optional: catch sites not in either group
  ))

ggplot(site_totals_filtered, aes(x = reorder(Site, Total_Trees), y = Total_Trees, fill = Treatment)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Treated" = "#e6b855", "Untreated" =  "#435e55ff", "Other" = "grey80")) +
  labs(title = "Total Live Trees per Site in 2025",
       x = "Site",
       y = "Number of Trees",
       fill = "Treatment Group") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

```{r, fig.width=8, fig.height=2.5}
filtered_2025 <- trees %>%
  filter(Year == 2025, !Tree_condition %in% c(2, 5, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12))

site_totals_filtered <- filtered_2025 %>%
  group_by(Site) %>%
  summarise(Total_Trees = n())

treated_sites <- c("SFF1", "SFF5", "SFF7", "SFF8", "SFF10", "SFS4")
untreated_sites <- c("SFF2", "SFF3", "SFF4", "SFF6", "SFF9", "BTN4")  
adjust_sites <- c("SFF1", "SFF5", "SFF7", "SFF10", "SFF3", "SFF4", "SFF6", "SFF9")

site_totals_filtered <- site_totals_filtered %>%
  mutate(Total_Trees = ifelse(Site %in% adjust_sites, Total_Trees * 4, Total_Trees))


site_totals_filtered <- site_totals_filtered %>%
  mutate(Treatment = case_when(
    Site %in% treated_sites ~ "Treated",
    Site %in% untreated_sites ~ "Untreated",
    TRUE ~ "Other"  # Optional: catch sites not in either group
  ))

ggplot(site_totals_filtered, aes(x = reorder(Site, Total_Trees), y = Total_Trees, fill = Treatment)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", color = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Treated" = "#e6b855", "Untreated" =  "#435e55ff", "Other" = "grey80")) +
  labs(title = "Tree density by plot, 2025",
       x = "",
       y = "Trees/ha",
       fill = "Treatment Group") +
   theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")+
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12, face = "plain"),
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 4000))
``` 

```{r all_cond}
filtered_2025 <- trees %>%
  filter(Year == 2025)

treated_sites <- c("SFF1", "SFF5", "SFF7", "SFF8", "SFF10", "SFS4")
untreated_sites <- c("SFF2", "SFF3", "SFF4", "SFF6", "SFF9", "BTN4")

summary_2025ALLCOND <- filtered_2025 %>%
  filter(Site %in% c(treated_sites, untreated_sites)) %>%
  group_by(Site) %>%
  summarise(Total_Trees = n(), .groups = 'drop') %>%
  mutate(Treatment = case_when(
    Site %in% treated_sites ~ "Treated",
    Site %in% untreated_sites ~ "Untreated"
  )) %>%
  group_by(Treatment) %>%
  summarise(
    Sum_Trees = sum(Total_Trees),           # total trees for the treatment
    SE_Trees = sqrt(sum((Total_Trees - mean(Total_Trees))^2)) / sqrt(n()),  # standard error of the sum approximation
    Trees_Divided_By_3 = Sum_Trees / 3,
    SE_Divided_By_3 = SE_Trees / 3,
    .groups = 'drop'
  )

fig1 <- ggplot(summary_2025ALLCOND, aes(x = Treatment, y = Trees_Divided_By_3, fill = Treatment)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", color = 'black') +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = Trees_Divided_By_3 - SE_Divided_By_3, 
                    ymax = Trees_Divided_By_3 + SE_Divided_By_3),
                width = 0.2) +
  ylim(0, 1800) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Treated" = "#e6b855", "Untreated" = "#435e55ff")) +
  labs(title = "Tree density",
       x = "",
       y = "Trees/ha") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_text(size = 14),       # axis tick labels
    axis.title = element_text(size = 16),      # y-axis title (no x label)
    legend.title = element_text(size = 16),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 14)
  )+
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        plot.title = element_text(size = 18))


fig1



```

```{r}
                width = 0.2) +
  ylim(0, 225) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Treated" = "#e6b855", "Untreated" = "#435e55ff")) +
  labs(title = "Mature/old growth density",
       x = "",
       y = "Tot OG & MOG/ha") +
  theme_classic() +
 theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_text(size = 14),       # axis tick labels
    axis.title = element_text(size = 16),      # y-axis title (no x label)
    legend.title = element_text(size = 16),

  )+
```

```{r}
treated_sites <- c("SFF1", "SFF5", "SFF7", "SFF8", "SFF10", "SFS4")
untreated_sites <- c("SFF2", "SFF3", "SFF4", "SFF6", "SFF9", "BTN4")

filtered_2025_Moglive <- trees %>%
  filter(
    Year == 2025, Tree_condition %in% c(1,3,7), 
    (DBH > 30 | OG == "Y")
  )

summary_2025MOGlive <- filtered_2025_Moglive %>%
  filter(Site %in% c(treated_sites, untreated_sites)) %>%
  group_by(Site) %>%
  summarise(Total_Trees = n(), .groups = 'drop') %>%
  mutate(Treatment = case_when(
    Site %in% treated_sites ~ "Treated",
    Site %in% untreated_sites ~ "Untreated"
  )) %>%
  group_by(Treatment) %>%
  summarise(
    Sum_Trees = sum(Total_Trees),           # total trees for the treatment
    SE_Trees = sqrt(sum((Total_Trees - mean(Total_Trees))^2)) / sqrt(n()),  # standard error of the sum approximation
    Trees_Divided_By_3 = Sum_Trees / 3,
    SE_Divided_By_3 = SE_Trees / 3,
    .groups = 'drop'
  )

fig3.live <- ggplot(summary_2025MOGlive, aes(x = Treatment, y = Trees_Divided_By_3, fill = Treatment)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", color = 'black') +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = Trees_Divided_By_3 - SE_Divided_By_3, 
                    ymax = Trees_Divided_By_3 + SE_Divided_By_3),
                width = 0.2) +
  ylim(0, 225) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Treated" = "#e6b855", "Untreated" = "#435e55ff")) +
  labs(title = "Live mature/old growth density",
       x = "",
       y = "Live OG & MOG/ha") +
  theme_classic() +
 theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_text(size = 14),       # axis tick labels
    axis.title = element_text(size = 16),      # y-axis title (no x label)
    legend.title = element_text(size = 16),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 14)
  )+
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        plot.title = element_text(size = 18))
```

```{r}
treated_sites <- c("SFF1", "SFF5", "SFF7", "SFF8", "SFF10", "SFS4")
untreated_sites <- c("SFF2", "SFF3", "SFF4", "SFF6", "SFF9", "BTN4")

trees_2025 <- trees %>%
  filter(Year == 2025) %>%
  mutate(Treatment = case_when(
    Site %in% treated_sites ~ "Treated",
    Site %in% untreated_sites ~ "Untreated",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Treatment))

species_counts <- trees_2025 %>%
  group_by(Treatment, SpeciesID) %>%
  summarise(Tree_Count = n(), .groups = "drop")

total_counts <- species_counts %>%
  group_by(Treatment) %>%
  summarise(Total_Trees = sum(Tree_Count), .groups = "drop")

species_composition <- species_counts %>%
  left_join(total_counts, by = "Treatment") %>%
  mutate(Proportion = Tree_Count / Total_Trees)

species_order <- c("PSME", "PIST", "ABCO", "PIPO", "SASC", "POTR",
                   "PIED", "QUUN", "QUGA", "ACGL", "PRVI", "JUMO", 
                   "JUSC", "unknown", "NA")

# Convert SpeciesID to factor with desired order (rev() for top-down stacking)
species_composition <- species_composition %>%
  mutate(SpeciesID = factor(SpeciesID, levels = (species_order)))

# Plot proportional stacked bar chart
ggplot(species_composition, aes(x = Treatment, y = Proportion, fill = SpeciesID)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("ABCO" = "#4EDFC7",

                               "QUGA" = "#CC5500",
                               "QUUN" = "#E3963E",
                               "SASC" = "#AFE1AF",
                               "unknown"= "#808080",
                               "NA" = "#808080")) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::number_format(accuracy = 0.1)) +  # Shows 0.0, 0.5, 1.0
  labs(title = "Species Composition in 2025 by Treatment Group",
       x = "Treatment Group",
       y = "Proportion of Individuals",
       fill = "Species") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
# Function to extract legend from a ggplot
get_legend <- function(myplot) {
  tmp <- ggplotGrob(myplot)
  leg <- gtable::gtable_filter(tmp, "guide-box")
  return(leg)
# Assume plot9 (treated) and plot10 (untreated) are already defined
# Remove legends from plots
plot9_noleg <- plot9 + theme(legend.position = "none")
plot10_noleg <- plot10 + theme(legend.position = "none")

# Extract legend from one of the plots
shared_legend <- get_legend(plot9)

# Combine plots with shared legend on the right
grid.arrange(
  arrangeGrob(plot9_noleg, plot10_noleg, ncol = 2),
  shared_legend,
  ncol = 2,
  widths = c(4, 1)  # Adjust widths so legend isn't too small
)
```

```{r}
treated_sites <- c("SFF1", "SFF5", "SFF7", "SFF8", "SFF10", "SFS4")
untreated_sites <- c("SFF2", "SFF3", "SFF4", "SFF6", "SFF9", "BTN4")

# Step 1: Filter 2025 data and assign Treatment
filtered_trees <- trees %>%
  filter(Year == 2025, !is.na(SpeciesID), !is.na(Site), Site %in% c(treated_sites, untreated_sites),
  !Tree_condition %in% c(2, 5, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12)) %>%
  mutate(
    Treatment = case_when(
      Site %in% treated_sites ~ "Treated",
      Site %in% untreated_sites ~ "Untreated"
    )
  )

# Step 2: Create species abundance matrix per plot
species_matrix <- filtered_trees %>%
  group_by(Site, SpeciesID) %>%
  summarise(Abundance = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = SpeciesID, values_from = Abundance, values_fill = 0)

# Step 3: Calculate Shannon index
plot_ids <- species_matrix$Site
species_matrix_only <- species_matrix %>% select(-Site)
shannon_values <- diversity(species_matrix_only, index = "shannon")

# Clean Site and Year columns
trees <- trees %>%
  mutate(
    Site = trimws(toupper(Site)),
    Year = as.numeric(Year)
  )

# Step 4: Add treatment info back
plot_treatments <- filtered_trees %>%
  select(Site, Treatment) %>%
  distinct()
diversity_data <- data.frame(
  Site = plot_ids,

  Shannon = shannon_values
) %>%
  left_join(plot_treatments, by = "Site")

# Step 5: t-test
cat("\nT-test comparing Shannon Diversity between Treated and Untreated sites (2025):\n")
t_test_result <- t.test(Shannon ~ Treatment, data = diversity_data)
print(t_test_result)

t_test_result <- t.test(Shannon ~ Treatment, data = diversity_data)
print(t_test_result)

ggplot(diversity_data, aes(x = Treatment, y = Shannon, fill = Treatment)) +
  geom_boxplot(color = "black", alpha = 0.8) +  # black outlines, slightly transparent fill
  labs(
    title = "Shannon Diversity Index by Treatment (2025)",
    x = "Treatment Group",
    y = "Shannon Index"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Treated" = "#e6b855",    # custom green
      "Untreated" = "#435e55ff"   # custom orange
    )
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16, hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = "none",  # remove legend if not needed
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

##"Treated" = "#e6b855", "Untreated" = "#435e55ff"
``` 

```{r}
target_species <- c("ABCO", "PIED", "PIPO", "PIST", "PSME", "QUGA")

# define treatment groups
treated_sites <- c("SFF1", "SFF5", "SFF7", "SFF8", "SFF10", "SFS4")
untreated_sites <- c("SFF2", "SFF3", "SFF4", "SFF6", "SFF9", "BTN4")

# function to run tests for one species
run_tests_for_species <- function(sp) {
  
  dat <- trees_newdeathsfr %>%
    filter(SpeciesID == sp) %>%
    mutate(
      Treatment = ifelse(Site %in% treated_sites, "Treated", "Untreated"),
      dead = Tree_condition == 6,
      alive = Tree_condition != 6
    ) %>%
    group_by(Treatment) %>%
    summarise(
      dead = sum(dead),
      alive = sum(alive),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  # build 2×2 contingency matrix
  mat <- as.matrix(dat[, c("dead", "alive")])
  rownames(mat) <- dat$Treatment
  
  list(
    species = sp,
    table = mat,
    chi_square = chisq.test(mat, correct = FALSE),
    fisher = fisher.test(mat)
  )
}

# run for all species
results <- map(target_species, run_tests_for_species)

results
```
